title: Jenny AI joins the creative apps directory
summary:
A community-directory day: Jenny AI joined the listings, while Elixpo’s projects got clearer credits and a little housekeeping.

Jenny AI was added to the README and website directory. The character-creation chatbot uses Pollinations for image generation and vision.

The README and website project lists now credit Ayushman Bhattacharya for Pollinations Feed and the Elixpo Art Chrome Extension. The README also groups the Elixpo projects together.

A duplicate Chrome Extension listing was removed from the website, and Pollinations Feed’s README description now focuses on its realtime bento-grid interface.
